original.target_description: Matching original article, Study 2, printed pp.14–16 / PDF pp.7–9. Novel personality-group categorization of elderly/young Black/White male targets, germ aversion (GA), perceived infectability (PI), and disease-versus-weather prime. Broad description and p.7 locator do not distinguish main effect, GA interaction, three-way interaction, or simple effects; target test unresolved.
